brief:
Terrorist settlers stormed Khirbet Samra in the northern Jordan Valley tonight, Shehab Wire reported. The community, located in the occupied West Bank's Jordan Valley region, has faced repeated incursions by Israeli settlers in recent months.

The raid is the latest in an escalating pattern of nighttime attacks on Palestinian villages and hamlets across the territory. Khirbet Samra, a small Palestinian settlement in one of the West Bank's most volatile areas, remains vulnerable to such operations.
